articles.title: Wall Street ticks lower as first earnings reports trickle in ahead of latest US inflation data
articles.mainIdea: Wall Street ticks lower as first earnings reports trickle in ahead of latest US inflation data
articles.summary: Associated Press: Wall Street ticks lower as first earnings reports trickle in ahead of latest US inflation data. U.S. markets inched slightly lower before the opening bell Tuesday as investors pore over the first big earnings reports before turning their attention to the government's latest inflation data. JPMorgan shares rose less than 1% after the New York investment bank beat Wall Street's revenue and profit forecasts on a strong performance in markets and growth in its consumer banking division. Delta Air Lines, which just barely beat Wall Street's fourth-quarter targets, tumbled 5% after its 2026 guidance disappointed investors. Related tickers mentioned: AXP, DAL, SYF, ^DJI, ^GSPC, ^IXIC.
